exec: pm.test('Yeni yollar ve yöntemler Swagger içinde',()=>{const text=pm.response.text();['/api/auth/me','/api/projects','/api/projects/{id}','/api/tasks','/api/tasks/{id}','"patch"'].forEach(v=>pm.expect(text).to.include(v));});
